description: This file contains utility classes and functions for constructing, managing, and decoding responses and request parameters related to API interactions within the litellm project. It includes methods for handling response identifiers, converting text formats, extracting headers, and logging utilities tailored for response API usage.

classes.name: ResponsesAPIRequestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for constructing, decoding, and manipulating response API request and response identifiers, managing parameters, and converting response data formats.

classes.name: ResponseAPILoggingUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging and transforming response API usage data, useful for monitoring and debugging response API interactions.
